targetReport.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, Sixth Edition (BPM6)
targetReport.publisher: International Monetary Fund
targetReport.description: The IMF's standard for compiling the balance of payments and the international investment position — the accounting framework for a country's transactions and positions with the rest of the world. release_schedule.note: BPM6 itself (the report this entry is about) is a one-off manual published in prepublication form Dec 2008 / final 2009 and is now superseded by BPM7, released 2025-03-20 (IMF press release PR25/072). The IMF revises this manual jointly with the UN's System of National Accounts (SNA) roughly every 15-17 years: BPM5 (1993) -> BPM6 (2008/2009, ~15-16 yrs) -> BPM7 (2025, ~16-17 yrs). No fixed/stated periodicity rule exists; the ~2041 date is a rough projection from the historical pattern, not an announced IMF target.

targetReport.title: Principles and Recommendations for Population and Housing Censuses
targetReport.publisher: United Nations Statistics Division (Department of Economic and Social Affairs)
targetReport.description: The UN's standard guidance on planning, conducting and disseminating a population and housing census, including the characteristics of the population and housing that should be measured. Issued since 1958 and revised once each decennial census round to keep national censuses internationally comparable; Revision 3 covers the 2020 round and Revision 4 the 2030 round. Country code is CA only because the schema offers no international option.
targetReport.cadence_note: Revised once per decennial census round — roughly every ten years. Not an annual release; releases_per_year is nominal.

entries.covers: Revision 3, endorsed by the UN Statistical Commission's 46th session, for the 2020 census round
Revision 4, submitted for approval/endorsement by the UN Statistical Commission's 56th session (March 2025), for the 2030 census round
Projected next revision (Revision 5), for the 2040 census round, based on the observed once-per-census-round (~10-year) revision pattern

release_schedule.note: This is not an annually or fixed-cycle publication; it is revised roughly once per ten-year UN census round, timed to precede/coincide with the start of the next round's preparations. Revision 1 dates to 1958; Revision 2 to 1980; Revision 3 to 2015 (2020 round); Revision 4 was adopted in 2025 (2030 round, Statistical Commission 56th session). No revision has yet been announced/scheduled for the 2040 round, so 2035 is a projection extrapolated from the historical cadence, not a published date. releases_per_year=0.1 (once per ~10 years) on file is consistent with this pattern.
